invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list due to .collect(Collectors.toList()), which never returns null.
The stream pipeline is called on data (data.stream()), which would throw NullPointerException if data were null, so data must be non-null at method exit.
The return value is always a List, as per the method's declared return type and implementation.
parallelStream().parallel() is used; parallelism should be greater than 0 for meaningful parallel execution.
The number of result elements is at most the number of input elements, because the grouping is by key and then reduction.
